data.name: Maitreyi
data.gender_notes: Maitreyi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maitreyi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘maitra’ which means friend. The name signifies a friendly, amiable, and compassionate nature. It is believed that the name Maitreyi was given to the beloved wife of the sage Yajnavalkya in Hindu mythology. The name Maitreyi carries the meaning “Friendly, Amiable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Maitreyi usually hope their child will grow to embody friendly, amiable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Maitreyi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friendly, Amiable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maitreyi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Maitreyi is a popular name in various regions of India and Nepal. It is considered an auspicious name, especially for girls, as it implies the qualities of being kind, loving, and having a good nature. The name carries the essence of strong female bonds, cherished friendships, and emotional connections. In some communities, Maitreyi is also considered a name for a goddess and is revered in religious practices.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name Maitreyi holds deep meaning as it represents spiritual friendship. Yajnavalkya, a wise sage, had multiple wives, but his most cherished and beloved wife was Maitreyi. Their bond was a perfect example of selfless friendship and devotion. The story of Maitreyi and Yajnavalkya is a significant reminder that nurturing friendships is an essential part of spiritual growth. The name inspires individuals to seek spiritual connections and to remain compassionate and loving towards others. Through the name, we are reminded of the importance of having a kind heart and fostering deep friendships.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Maitreyi, meaning 'friend', symbolizes the deep bond of camaraderie and mutual respect between individuals. It embodies the spiritual ideal of selfless love and unity, emphasizing the importance of cherishing relationships and fostering harmony.
